reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x00404010 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/go/00404010-GOGfxDevice.cpp at sha256 1af83c7e4414def9221be0702d31ac086677e5fe8db6ec19ecb6a6c0349a0610 (recorded implementation.signature: int32_t GOGfxDevice(int32_t param_1, float param_2);). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

divergences: Frame pointer read from [E+8] instead of [E+0xc].
candidate_comparison.statement: Divergences are listed above; by contract they keep the record at TRANSCRIBED or lower.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail entry 0x00404010 is recovered by all three tools; the address-bound implementation is scripts/GameNatives/go/00404010-GOGfxDevice.cpp (sha256 1af83c7e4414def9221be0702d31ac086677e5fe8db6ec19ecb6a6c0349a0610). Single block 0x404010-0x40407F: Sys_ResolveSymbol_23(frame,0,&g_bc1e43[g_bc2380*0x45*0x14],0x100); memcpy([E+4],{0,0,0,&g_script_ret_type},0x18); return arg1.

checks.name: abi_and_signature
checks.detail: Retail frame [E+0xc]; BN (int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc); candidate param_2 at [E+8].The retail frame slot is [E+0xc] (BN already models it as arg2/arg3 with an explicit @ 0xc offset). The candidate declaration puts its second (or third) parameter at [E+8], the registered argc slot, so the same source compiled into the QVM call site would read the wrong stack word.

checks.detail: Retail CFG: Binary Ninja reports 1 block(s)/0 edge(s) at 0x00404010; radare2 recovers the identical 1 block(s)/0 edge(s) (score 1.0000); angr CFGFast recovers 4 block(s) with has_unresolved_jumps=False.

checks.detail: One 0x004B8A80 Sys_ResolveSymbol_23(frame,0,dest,0x100); the candidate passes the argc word.

checks.detail: Device string destination correct; frame read wrong; result record at [E+4].

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "int32_t(int32_t arg1, float arg2 @ 0xc)" at 0x00404010; radare2 recovers "fcn.00404010 (int32_t arg_34h, int32_t arg_24h);". Both tools place the entry at 0x00404010 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame. Candidate declaration: int32_t GOGfxDevice(int32_t param_1, float param_2);. The candidate declaration is separately recorded as divergent below and does not satisfy the retail ABI.
